rationale: Panel exhibits a dominant cyclical mean-reversion factor with a clean break at lag 120: returns over t-250 to t-120 predict positively while returns over t-120 to t predict negatively, and the legs are additive. The compact form ret(250) minus 2x ret(120) captures both legs with equal weight (train SR 1.93, IC 0.012) and sits on a broad robustness plateau: SR 1.86-1.95 across every vol-scaling denominator, component-z and ensemble variants, and it decays gracefully under extra implementation lag. Reporting the raw form plus two vol-scaled variants (std 40 and std 120 denominators) as structurally hedged implementations of the same well-identified factor; weaker independent families (MA crossover, beta, corrm) were tested and excluded because every blend diluted portfolio Sharpe.
